records.title: Humboldt Research Fellowship
records.deadline_display: Corresponding to the three selection rounds per year, there will be three calls for applications annually, each opening approximately eight months before the respective selection meeting. Once a call has reached the maximum number of currently 800 applications, the application round will be closed.

source.as_of: Page fetched 2026-10-05; it states the current call has reached the maximum number of applications and gives a 'Calls schedule for 2026' (calls opening 15 March 2026, 15 July 2026, 15 November 2026).
source.raw_extract: We have received the maximum number of applications for the current call. Therefore, unfortunately, no new applications can be created at present. The next call will open on November 15, 2026. | Deadlines: Corresponding to the three selection rounds per year, there will be three calls for applications annually, each opening approximately eight months before the respective selection meeting. Once a call has reached the maximum number of currently 800 applications, the application round will be closed. Applicants who have already started their application at that time will be able to save and continue working on it but will not be able to submit until the next call opens. | Calls schedule: Call opens ... on 15 March / ... on 15 July / ... on 15 November
source.exact_deadline_wording: Once a call has reached the maximum number of currently 800 applications, the application round will be closed.
source.notes: No calendar submission deadline exists for this programme. The Foundation publishes call OPENING dates only (15 March / 15 July / 15 November); each round closes when it reaches a cap of 800 applications, i.e. first-come, volume-based closure. 15 November 2026 is an opening date, not a deadline, so it is not written as deadline_date. Retrieved page is the live official programme page; no cached copy was used.

records.title: International Industrial Talents Education Special Program (INTENSE Program)

source.publisher: National Sun Yat-sen University (NSYSU) Startup Quarter / Career Development Office
source.as_of: Page fetched 2026-10-05; describes the national INTENSE Programme run by the Ministry of Education with the National Development Council, with no year attached to the intake windows it lists.
source.raw_extract: In response to the declining birthrate in Taiwan, the industry's demand for mid- to high-level talents, and the need to strengthen the domestic labor structure, the Ministry of Education, in coordination with the National Development Council, is promoting the "International Industrial Talents Education Special Program (INTENSE Program)" ... | 📅 Application Timeline Overview ... Spring Intake – First Round (Early Oct – Late Dec) Spring Intake – Second Round (Early Apr – Late Jun) Fall Intake – First Round (Early Apr – Late Jun) Fall Intake – Second Round (Early Oct – Late Dec)
source.exact_deadline_wording: Spring Intake – First Round (Early Oct – Late Dec) / Spring Intake – Second Round (Early Apr – Late Jun) / Fall Intake – First Round (Early Apr – Late Jun) / Fall Intake – Second Round (Early Oct – Late Dec)
source.notes: No single INTENSE application deadline exists at programme level. The official INTENSE page reachable here (a participating Taiwanese university) publishes only the school-side intake round structure in month ranges with no day, no year and no applicant-facing closing date, and it is not a source for a deadline for this national programme. The shard's own official_source_url (gocfs.ntu.edu.tw) is NTU's Office of Student Affairs page for overseas compatriot and mainland Chinese students and contains nothing about INTENSE, so it cannot establish a deadline. No date invented; deadline_date left null. Individual participating universities publish entirely different windows (e.g. ISU 2025-11-17 to 2025-12-12, CCU 2026-01-15 to 2026-04-15, KMU 2026-02-02 to 2026-03-16, Providence 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-10, NTCUST 2026-04-07 to 2026-05-03, Hungkuo 2026-04-22 to 2026-05-15), which confirms the deadline is per-institution rather than programme-wide.

records.deadline_display: Applicants must submit the following documents to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of the applicant's nationality by the designated deadline.

source.publisher: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
source.as_of: FY2027 cycle: 'JAPANESE GOVERNMENT (MEXT) SCHOLARSHIP FOR 2027', published 2026-04-20, linked from MEXT's 募集中のプログラム listing as of 2026-10-05.
source.raw_extract: 10. APPLICATION DOCUMENTS Applicants must submit the following documents to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of the applicant's nationality by the designated deadline. The submitted documents will not be returned. | (12) If there are any questions about the content of the written text in this Application Guidelines or any other matters, applicants/grantees should inquire at the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of the applicant's nationality and follow their instructions. | (4) Applicants will be informed of the final selection results by the Japanese diplomatic mission in the applicant's country after February 2027.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applicants must submit the following documents to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of the applicant's nationality by the designated deadline.
source.notes: MEXT publishes no applicant-facing deadline for this programme: the 2027 guidelines require submission to the applicant's own Japanese diplomatic mission 'by the designated deadline' and tell applicants to follow that mission's instructions. No calendar date exists on the MEXT page to record, so deadline_date stays null. Not labelled CONFLICTING because there is no disagreement between two sources; MEXT simply states the deadline is set by each mission. The shard's own official_source_url (mext.go.jp/en/.../sdetail02/1373897.htm) resolves to the generic MEXT 'STUDY in JAPAN' page with no deadline for this programme.

source.as_of: FY2027 cycle: 'JAPANESE GOVERNMENT (MEXT) SCHOLARSHIP FOR 2027 (RESEARCH STUDENTS)', published 2026-04-20, linked from MEXT's 募集中のプログラム listing as of 2026-10-05.
source.raw_extract: 8. THE PROCESS OF APPLICATION AND SELECTION <Notes> Call for applications opens at each Japanese diplomatic mission / Submission of application documents: The deadline for submission of application documents varies according to each Japanese diplomatic mission. Make sure to confirm the deadline at the website of the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of your nationality or in some other way. | Applicants who pass the first screening shall submit a completed Placement Preference Application Form to the Japanese diplomatic mission. The deadline for submission of this form varies according to each Japanese diplomatic mission. | 9. APPLICATION DOCUMENTS Applicants must submit the following documents to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of the applicant's nationality by the designated deadline. | (6) Applicants will be notified by the Japanese diplomatic mission of the final selection results and the grantees' accepting university from January 2027 to early March 2027.
source.exact_deadline_wording: The deadline for submission of application documents varies according to each Japanese diplomatic mission. Make sure to confirm the deadline at the website of the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of your nationality or in some other way.
source.notes: MEXT explicitly states there is no central deadline for this programme because each Japanese diplomatic mission sets its own, so no calendar date exists to record and none is inferred. Labelled UNKNOWN rather than CONFLICTING: the brief reserves CONFLICTING for two credible sources disagreeing about the same deadline, whereas here a single official source states the deadline is mission-specific. Final-selection notification is only given as a range (January 2027 to early March 2027), which is a result date and not a deadline, so it is not used.
